elements.element: Cap is mutual (applies to each Party)
elements.evidence: "each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed"

elements.element: Cap amount is the greater of the two limbs
elements.evidence: "shall not exceed the greater of (a) ... and (b) USD 1,000,000"

elements.element: Fee limb = fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: "fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim by AbbVie under this Agreement"
"NEITHER PARTY NOR ANY OF ITS AFFILIATES SHALL BE LIABLE FOR INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, EXEMPLARY, PUNITIVE OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for breach of confidentiality obligations
elements.evidence: carve-out incorporates "(B) FOR A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS OBLIGATIONS UNDER [ARTICLE 9 OR SECTION 5.8]" via "Except for the matters described in clauses (A) through (D) of Section 11.5"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for data protection obligations
elements.evidence: "for a Party's breach of its data protection or security obligations ... for which liability is not capped"
"its data protection or security obligations ... liability is not capped"
clause "(D) ... A CLAIM FOR WHICH A PARTY PROVIDES INDEMNIFICATION UNDER THIS ARTICLE 11" excepted from the cap
"(A) FOR FRAUD, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR GROSS NEGLIGENCE" excepted from cap

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: "or its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights, for which liability is not capped"

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not damages for cap purposes
elements.evidence: "Customer's payment obligations under this Agreement, and all amounts due, are not damages for purposes of the foregoing cap"

elements.element: Mutual cap of 12 months' fees (fallback amount)
elements.evidence: cap is "the greater of (a) fees ... and (b) USD 1,000,000", not a cap equal to 12 months' fees

elements.element: Fallback carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: "Except for the matters described in clauses (A) through (D) of Section 11.5" (fraud/wilful misconduct/gross negligence, Article 9 breach, indemnification)

reasons: All preferred atomic elements are present: mutual aggregate cap at the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, retained mutual indirect/consequential waiver, and uncapped carve-outs for fraud, wilful misconduct, gross negligence, confidentiality (Article 9/5.8), indemnification, data protection, security and the other Party's IP.
Minimality fails on the redundant phrase "and all amounts due", which duplicates the payment-obligations sentence and is not needed to complete the preferred level.

Preserves intent fails: this Agreement is between Harpoon and AbbVie and contains no defined term "Customer"; the inserted sentence's reference to "Customer's payment obligations" is a dangling undefined term and should read "AbbVie's payment obligations" (or "a Party's payment obligations").

The greater-of construct literally exceeds the fallback's "cap of 12 months' fees", so the fallback bargain is not satisfied on its own terms; that is acceptable here only because the locked target is preferred.
